Scenario data

A complete starting dataset for 67 airports. Prices follow the same formula, and flight inputs follow the route and aircraft you choose. Change the assumptions here to update your model.

01 / Shared assumptions

Build a consistent price picture

The starting base of USD 800/t gives every airport a common reference. Regional adjustments create an explicit supply scenario. Distance to a regional reference airport adds a transport proxy, followed by service and tax adjustments.

The default supply cap is 120 tonnes per visit. Lower it to test a supply constraint. The reference airports organise the distance calculation, while regional price adjustments remain editable scenario choices.

Regional supply assumptions

These starting adjustments create a spread of supply conditions to test the model. The Gulf and Southeast Asia form the lower-cost scenario, while other regions have progressively higher delivery adjustments. Change them to test a different market structure.

03 / Your route

Follow the inputs into the calculation

Choose a route

Airport coordinates give the great-circle distance. A route multiplier and cruise speed give flight time. Cruise, climb and taxi assumptions then give fuel burn. Reserves and the cost of carrying extra fuel are calculated separately.
